name: The Caffeinated Goat Protocol
format_rules: PYRAMID — 7 rounds. Each round, do every move for that round's number (climb up, then back down). Rest ~30 s between rounds. Cap 20 min — stop wherever you are.
twist: CLOCK DIGIT: look at the clock. The last digit of the minute = bonus reps added to your FIRST move every round.

warmup.cue: Hold the wall, swing each leg forward and back.
Interlace fingers, roll wrists in circles.
Roll shoulders up, back and down.

main.cue: Rise onto toes, pause, lower slowly. Hold a wall for balance.
Step back, both knees bend to 90°, push through front heel.
Sturdy chair only. Drive through the top foot, control the way down.

cooldown.cue: On your back, ankle on opposite knee, pull legs in.
Knees wide, sit back, arms long.
Lying face down, press up gently, hips stay down.
On your back, drop both knees to one side.
